Subject: POC planning - recap & next steps

Hi Sophie & Raj —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the POC kickstarted without losing momentum.

Recap (from today's discovery):
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for patient-facing summarization across 100k monthly notes; preserve PHI controls and meet < 150ms median token latency on dedicated capacity.
- Key success criteria you called out: accuracy vs internal baseline (ROUGE/Likert), latency, cost per 1k tokens, and acceptable security controls (audit logs + KMS).
- Evaluation window: 3 weeks preferred by Product; Procurement wants a 30-day trial option for contract alignment.

Proposed POC plan (high level):
1) Kickoff & infra readiness (week 0): network requirements + access, test dataset sample, account provisioning.
2) Ramp (week 1): pilot with 10k notes, measure latency/quality.
3) Scale & evaluate (weeks 2-3): full run, cost/quality analysis, deliver evaluation report.

Ownership (initial proposal):
- Acme infra/network: DevOps Lead <devops@acmehealth.com> (provisioning, firewall rules)
- Acme app/product: Sophie Turner (test datasets, acceptance criteria)
- Acme security/compliance: Procurement + Security reviewers (audit/KMS sign-off)
- Redwood: Marissa (PM / commercial), Rishi (SE / technical delivery), Logan (security questions)

Action items / next steps:
- Sophie: confirm infra contact and preferred trial length (30 days ok?).
- Raj: confirm internal success metrics and who owns procurement redlines.
- Redwood: send draft SOW & network reqs by EOD (attached).

Attachments: POC_SOW_v1.pdf, POC_Network_Reqs.xlsx (network checklist + ports).

If helpful, we can schedule a 30-minute kickoff tomorrow afternoon.

Best,

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications: 

- Trial length: Product prefers 3 weeks, Procurement will want a 30-day option. 30 days is fine as long as commercial terms are agreed.
- Infra contact: DevOps Lead (cc'd) will own firewall/VPC peering work.

- Quality: average Likert >= 3.5 vs. internal human baseline on a 1-5 scale, and no critical hallucinations on a 500-sample audit.
- Cost: target <= $X per 1k tokens (we'll share target range offline).

Subject: Re: POC planning - draft SOW, RACI, and proposed timeline

Hi all — attaching the draft SOW and the network checklist (attached). Key items included below and an explicit RACI so ownership is clear.

Proposed timeline (detailed):
- Day 0 (kickoff): confirm datasets, exchange test accounts, and complete network prep tasks.
- Week 1 (pilot): run 10k notes, baseline metrics, initial tuning.
- Week 2 (scale): run remaining sample, stress test concurrency, collect logs.
- Week 3 (analysis & report): final evaluation, cost modeling, and recommendation.

Success criteria (concrete):
- Latency: median per-token latency < 150ms for 95% of production-like requests.
- Quality: average Likert >= 3.5 across 1,000 sampled summaries; no >1% critical hallucination rate on audit set.
- Security: KMS integration validated, audit logs accessible to Acme security, and no sensitive data exfiltration.
- Ops: Redwood demonstrates sustained throughput at required concurrency for 48 hours.

RACI (one-line entries):
- Network/firewall rules: Responsible=DevOps Lead (Acme), Accountable=Acme DevOps, Consulted=Logan Wright (Redwood), Informed=Marissa.
- Test dataset curation: Responsible=Sophie (Acme), Accountable=Product, Consulted=Laura Bennett (Redwood CS), Informed=Marissa.
- Security sign-off (KMS/audit): Responsible=Acme Security, Accountable=Raj (exec sponsor), Consulted=Logan Wright (Redwood), Informed=Procurement.
- Technical delivery & tuning: Responsible=Rishi Malhotra (Redwood SE), Accountable=Redwood Eng Lead, Consulted=DevOps, Informed=Sophie.
- Commercial/contract: Responsible=Procurement (Acme), Accountable=Raj, Consulted=Marissa, Informed=Legal.

Attachments referenced: [Attachment: POC_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 124KB)], [Attachment: POC_Network_Reqs.xlsx (Excel, 32KB)].

Please confirm the RACI or suggest edits. If everyone is ok, we'll schedule the kickoff for tomorrow at 3pm PT and Rishi will send a short technical checklist before the meeting.

Best,
Marissa
